Commentary.Commentary: 1445 local update - We should have got started by now but unfortunately the rain has played spoilsport again. So we are all set for a delayed start. It could be a passing shower but the covers are in place.

Jos Buttler did not disappoint and he played a swashbuckling knock where he scored 61 in 48 balls. The Kiwi bowlers could hardly dominate against the home side. Corey Anderson was the most successful bowler along with Adam Milne. The former was lucky to get a couple of big wickets on freebies. The New Zealand bowled really well in the last 3 overs to keep England under 325. Seems like a total both teams would happy with. A good start from Kiwis would put the pressure back on the hosts. Join us back in a while for the chase.

A fantastic batting performance from England has helped them post a good total on the board. All the English batsmen stepped out and performed well except Jason Roy and Eoin Morgan who departed cheaply. Alex Hales and Joe Root got their respective fifties but neither of them could capitalise on that. Ben Stokes missed out on his fifty by a mere two runs but the platform was well set for Moeen Ali and Buttler.

OUT! Boult pulls out another stunner! Short delivery into the body, Jake Ball tries to fend it. Gets it off the bat towards the square leg region. Boult comes running in from mid-wicket and takes a superb diving catch. ENGLAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 310!
Jake Ball is the last man in.

OUT! Southee strikes! Shorter delivery outside off, Mark Wood goes back a bit and tries to slap it. Gets it straight towards the fielder at covers. Ross Taylor excepts it gleefully and another wicket bites the dust.
Length delivery around off, Buttler miscues his slog towards long on for a single.
Mark Wood walks out to the middle.

OUT! Milne gets his third! Short delivery into the batsman, Plunkett goes for the pull. Gets a top edge on it and the ball flies towards the fielder at mid on. Southee settles under the skier and takes it comfortably.
Length delivery around off, Buttler backs away and slams it towards mid on. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses which allows the batsmen to take the single easily.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler pulls it over mid-wicket. Santner puts in a dive to save two runs for his team.
Length delivery around middle, Buttler goes for the slog. Gets it off the inside edge towards square leg for a couple.
Two wides! Way wide outside off, Plunkett lets it through. Goes on an awkward bounce towards Ronchi who gets his body behind it. Still the batsmen run across for a bye.
SIX! Good shot! Short delivery into the body, Plunkett pulls it brutally over the backward square leg region for half a dozen.
Plunkett drives it towards mid off for a quick single.
Very full into the stumps, Plunkett gets it towards the keeper off the bottom half.
Fuller outside off, Buttler tries to slog it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads for a single.
Buttler misses his scoop again! Length delivery and Jos goes for a scoop but he fails to make contact.
Full toss outside off, Plunkett drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Plunkett drives it back to the bowler.
14th ODI fifty for Jos Buttler.
SIX! Shot! Short and wide outside off, Buttler muscles his slap over the mid off region for a maximum.
Short delivery down the leg side, Buttler goes for the scoop again but makes no contact this time.
Pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Powerful! Short delivery into the body, Plunkett pulls it in front of square leg for a boundary.
Leg bye! Slower delivery on a shorter length, Buttler goes for the pull but he fails to make contact. Gets hit on the body and the batsmen scamper across for a leg bye.
Short delivery into the batsman, Plunkett goes for the pull. Gets a top edge towards fine leg for a single.
Adam Milne is brought on for a bowl.
Full toss on the pads, Buttler clips it towards fine leg for a couple.

SIX! What a shot, Buttler! Length delivery in the line of the stumps, Buttler shuffles way across and plays the scoop. Gets it over the keeper's head for a maximum. That went way over the sight screen.
Short delivery outside off, Buttler tries to play the upper cut but fails to make contact.
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second.
Fuller outside off, Buttler carves it through the cover region for a couple.
Yorker outside off, Buttler tries to dig it out but fails to make contact.
Trent Boult is given the ball again.
Buttler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Shot! Another short delivery outside off, Buttler stays deep and pulls it hard through the mid-wicket region. Guptill tries to cut it off with a dive but fails to stop it as the ball races away to the fence.
Wide! Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler sways away from the line of the ball. The umpire signals it as a wide.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Buttler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Short delivery into the body, Buttler is too early into the pull. Misses it completely as the ball hits his shoulder. The ball balloons towards the keeper who takes an easy catch. The players appeal and the umpire stays undisturbed. Southee asks his captain to go for the review. Replays show there was no bat involved and the umpire was totally right. New Zealand have wasted their review.
New Zealand opt for a review for a caught behind appeal against Buttler.
Buttler miscues his pull on the off side.
Liam Plunkett is the next man in.

OUT! Umpire's call stays! Angling in from outside off, the ball does not spin much. Adil Rashid tries to clip it on the leg side but fails to make contact. Gets hit flush on the back thigh and the players appeal. The umpire acknowledges it and rules it out. England opt for the review. Replays show that it was plumb as there was no bat involved. The ball was pitched outside off, impact was in line and the ball was going on to hit the stumps.
Adil Rashid has gone upstairs to take a review against an LBW decision given against him.
Buttler punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Rashid cuts it past the fielder at point for three.
FOUR! Deft! Fires this one around off, Rashid goes for the slog at first but then improvises to play it really fine past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Buttler punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller around off, Rashid drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Very, very full around off, Rashid digs it out towards mid on for a single. 250 up for England.
Full toss in the line of the stumps, Buttler clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Lucky runs! Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler goes for the pull. Gets a top edge on it and the ball goes over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Rashid guides it towards third man for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tim Southee is back on. A passing shower is back on.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Quicker one around off, Rashid opens the face of his bat and guides it towards the fielder at point.
Quicker one around off, Buttler pushes it towards the extra cover region. Guptill tries to cut it off but misfields and the batsmen run a single comfortably.
Fuller into the stumps, Buttler drives it back to the bowler.
Wide outside off, Buttler lets it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Buttler stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, Buttler drives it through covers for a brace.
Mitchell Santner is called back for a bowl.
Length delivery around off, Rashid gets in the line of the ball to defend it.
Rashid clips it through the square leg region for a couple.
Four Leg Byes! Fuller into the pads, Rashid tries to clip it fine. Fails to make contact as the ball kisses the pads and races away to the fence.
Adil Rashid makes his way out to the middle!

OUT! Boult pulls out a stunner! Short delivery into the body, Ali again goes for the pull shot. The ball flies towards the backward square leg region. Boult leaps and dives to his left to pull a special catch out of thin air. Anderson gets his third and Moeen Ali has to walk back to the hut.
Fuller delivery outside off, Ali lofts it over the fielder at cover for a couple.
SIX! Ali, you beauty! Length delivery around off, Moeen Ali plays the slog. Executes it to perfection as the ball goes over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
Wide! The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely. The Umpire signals a wide.
Powerplay 3 has been taken. A maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Ali goes for the pull but gets it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ali punches it on the off side.
Length delivery around off, Ali drives it back to the bowler.
Full length delivery outside off, Buttler flays at it but gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Short delivery into the body, Ali pulls it through square leg for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Ali drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Moeen Ali gets an inside edge towards the keeper.
Nearly dragged on! Slower delivery on a shorter length, Buttler goes for a pull. Gets a bottom edge past the stumps towards the keeper for a single.
Short delivery around off, Buttler clips it away fine for a couple behind square.
Short delivery into the pads, Ali nudges it fine through the backward square leg region for a single.
Another short delivery and Buttler pulls it through square leg for a single.
Corey Anderson is back on.
Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Buttler shoulders his arms to it.
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Moeen Ali strides out to the middle!

OUT! Boult strikes finally! Short delivery into the batsman, Stokes goes to play the upper cut. Plays it towards the shorter side but against the wind. The second part makes him pay the price as the ball goes straight to the fielder at third man. Milne settles under it and makes no mistake. Stokes has to depart and New Zealand would be really happy to have him because he could be deadly in the fag end of the innings.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Angling across from a length around off, Buttler shuffles across and tries to play the predetermined scoop but he misses it completely.
Trent Boult is called back into the attack.
Pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Slower delivery on a short delivery around off, Buttler clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Short delivery into the batsman, Buttler pulls it through square leg for a brace.
Length delivery around off, Buttler gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
WIDE! Dug in way short down the leg side this time, Buttler ducks under it. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Bowls this one again way outside off, Stokes throws his bat at it. Gets it towards mid off from the bottom half for a single.
Fuller delivery way outside off, Stokes shoulder his arms to it.
Fuller into the pads, Stokes clips it towards wide mid on. The fielder from mid-wicket cannot stop it and the batsmen run a single.
On the pads, Stokes clips it fine but cannot beat the fielder at short fine leg. No runs taken.
Tossed up outside off, Buttler slaps it off the bottom half towards long on for a single.
Eased towards long on for a single. 200 up for England.
Stokes clips it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Mitchell Santner will bowl the next over!
Taylor stops a bullet there! Short delivery outside off, Stokes pulls it powerfully but straight to Ross Taylor at mid-wicket who stops it.
Stokes clips this one through the mid-wicket region for a couple.

FOUR! Super Ben! Length delivery around off, Stokes stays in his crease and presents the full face of the bat to drive it straight down the ground. Beats the mid off fielder and the ball races away to the fence.

Full and wide outside off, Stokes tries to whip it on the leg side. Gets a top edge on it and the ball flies over the backward point region. The fielder from third man cuts it off and the batsmen run a couple.
Fuller delivery outside off, Stokes drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Buttler punches it through covers for a single.
Adam Milne is called back into the attack.
Good length delivery outside off, Stokes clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Very full into the stumps, Buttler digs it out towards square leg off the inner half for a single. A stifled appeal is denied.
Jos Buttler is the next man in.

OUT! Dragged on! Corey Anderson strikes again! Back of a length delivery outside off, Root goes hard at it. Gets a thick inside edge and the ball goes onto disturb the stumps. He is unhappy and Corey Anderson gets another wicket on a freebie. Another English batsman could not make it big and that could hurt the Englishmen in the end.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.

SIX! Stokes welcomes Anderson in a superb fashion! Fuller delivery in the line of the stumps, Ben sends the ball packing deep into the stands straight down the ground. It had power written all over it.
Corey Anderson is back for a bowl.
Dabbed towards third man for a single.
Way outside off this time, Stokes throws his bat at it but fails to make contact.
Wide outside off, Stokes cuts it past the fielder at point for a couple.
Stokes stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at point.

Nearly a run out! Good length delivery outside off, Stokes punches it towards the fielder at point. Broom stops it well and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Root was looking for a single. Broom misses and Joe is safe. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Another slower delivery on a shorter length, Root pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Root goes for a pull but he fails to make contact. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Short and just outside off, Ben Stokes plays the upper cut. Corey Anderson, from third man goes to his right and puts in a dive to save the boundary. The batsmen run a couple.
A bit short into the pads, Root shuffles across and pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery around off, Root defends it towards the point fielder off the outer half.
Stokes clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller delivery outside off, Stokes drives it elegantly through the extra cover region for a boundary. That was timed to perfection.
Back of a length delivery angling across, Stokes punches it towards mid off off the back foot.
Length delivery around off, Stokes flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, mistimes his punch towards the fielder at covers.
Another delivery on a good length outside off, Stokes slashes his blade at it but cannot make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Stokes stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at mid off.
Another short delivery, Root goes for the pull. Does not middle it well and the ball luckily falls well short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, the ball stays low. Root goes for the pull but he fails to make contact.
Tim Southee is called back into the attack.

Drinks break. Reasonably good phase for NZ with the two big wickets. Root continues to motor along and Stokes too is looking ominous. England are looking set for another 300-plus score at the moment unless NZ can keep getting wickets.
Length ball around off, tapped gently towards point.
Good length closer to off stump, Stokes defends it solidly from the crease.

FOUR! BANG! This is sheer power from Stokes and this time Root had to react quickly to avoid getting a blow. Steps out to a shortish ball and flat-bats it powerfully down the ground for a boundary. Mid off was in the ring and so it was a profitable stroke always.

NOT OUT! Good work from Neesham though. Stokes slaps it down the track and the bowler manages to get a bit of his fingertips on it as the ball crashes into the stumps at the non-striker's end. They go upstairs to see if it is a run out but Root was well in.
They are going upstairs. Neesham has deflected it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Root seems to be safe but the umpires want to be doubly sure.
On a good length around off, punched firmly back to the bowler.
On a good length angling across the left-hander, Stokes lets it pass.
Jimmy Neesham is back.
Fullish ball on off stump, Stokes shuffles a bit and wrists it towards long on. Powerfully struck but the fielder near the ropes is quite sharp and keeps the batsmen to a single.
Another full ball outside off, Stokes eases it back to Anderson who stops it in his followthrough.
Fuller outside off, Stokes presses forward and blocks it firmly to cover.
Switches to around the wicket but Anderson continues to struggle. Length ball but again a touch straight, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

Root is doing this easily. Another length ball on middle and leg, clips it through square leg for another brace. Anderson isn't bowling to his field. Brendon McCullum on air is clearly unhappy as it is a 6-3 field which means the line should be outside off.
Fuller ball on the pads, Root shuffles a bit and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Back of a length on leg stump, Stokes hops across and clips it through backward square leg. The man at fine leg races to his right to mop up as the batsmen take two.
Length ball angled into Stokes, chops it towards mid-wicket with a closed bat face.
Shorter in length around off stump, Stokes gets back to block but gets it off the splice towards the off side. A bit of extra bounce.
FOUR! SHOT! Slower ball around off, he picks it early and drives beautifully past mid off. Touch too full from Boult and Stokes doesn't miss out. The southpaw is off and running pretty quickly.
Length ball outside off, hangs back and blocks it firmly to the off side.
Short ball around leg stump, Stokes ducks under it quickly.
Trent Boult is back on.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to cover where Guptill fumbles to allow the single.

SIX! STOKES SPECIAL! He has the ability to manufacture maximums out of nowhere. This is shortish but not that bad a ball really, he goes back in a flash and clubs it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Easy bat swing yet so powerful. He can be lethal once he gets going.
Fuller and outside off, Stokes gets a big stride forward and pats it towards cover.
On a length outside off, Stokes reaches out and drills it towards cover.
Good length wider outside off, Stokes doesn't offer a stroke.
Fullish ball around middle, wristed to the left of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, drilled through the covers for a single.

FOUR! A bit streaky but safe! Floated around off, Root goes for the reverse sweep but hasn't quite got hold of it. Flies over short third man and it races to the fence for a boundary. Taylor had put in a slide to mop up but his foot touched the ropes in the process.
Floated around off, Root uses his feet and blocks well.
Floated around off stump, Stokes pushes it back down the track. Santner is wrong-footed and by the time he decides to go to the right direction, the ball is past him towards the deep. Single taken.
22nd ODI fifty for Root.
Flatter ball on the stumps, punched down the ground to long on for a single.
Floated around off, defended solidly from the crease.
Mitchell Santner is back on.
Another wide length ball outside off, Stokes lets it pass.
On a length outside off, Stokes rocks back and blocks well.
Fired well wide outside off, another leave and this time it's a wide.
Speared well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Ben Stokes is the new man in. The drizzle has picked up intensity.

OUT! MORGAN DEPARTS! This is an absolute gift for New Zealand and they know it. Anderson bowls a half-volley very wide outside off, it's there to be put away but Morgan only manages a thin feather on it after stepping out. Ronchi accepts it with glee and the caught behind appeal is accepted almost instantly by the umpire. The in-form captain has to go. Good passage of play for NZ here, two big wickets of Hales and Morgan in fairly quick succession.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards the right of mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Corey Anderson is back.
Shortish again around off stump, this is at a comfortable height and Morgan pulls it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Second slip comes out, sweeper cover is in place.

FOUR! Not entirely in control is Morgan but gets it away! Short ball around off stump, he pulls but gets it slightly off the top half of the blade. Aerial too but nobody in the deep at backward square leg. Boundary to the total.
Unlucky for Morgan! Should have got a boundary. Lovely straight drive off the fuller ball and it's hit dead straight. The ball slows down due to making contact with the sawdust. Brace added.
It has started to drizzle again.
Short ball around off stump, Morgan swivels to pull but gets a bottom edge on to the track. He got ruffled by the momentum of the delivery and lost his balance.
Back of a length around off stump, keeps a bit low as Morgan adjusts to get his bat down in time.
Short of a length outside off, Morgan hangs back and punches it towards extra cover.
On a good length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to cover.
Length ball around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Good yorker around off stump, Root does well to dig it out just in time.
Back of a length just outside off, Morgan cuts it late towards third man for a run.
Fullish ball on middle, Root wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Root stays back and punches it towards point.
Length ball outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.

FOUR! Intent from Morgan! This has been his success mantra. Positive from the outset irrespective of the situation and it's worked for him. Charges down the track and lofts it over extra cover. Not entirely off the middle but clears the infield with ease to find the fence.
PEACH! On a length in the corridor of uncertainty, nips in sharply with extra bounce as Morgan is beaten comprehensively.
Good length closer to off stump, Morgan hangs back and blocks it firmly to mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, Root gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it across the right-hander, a bit wide and Root chases it but is beaten.
Trent Boult is back on for another burst.
Eoin Morgan, the England captain, walks out to bat.

OUT! MILNE HAS HIS REVENGE! Decides to bowl a slower one and it pays off. Hales is rooted in the crease and looks to whip across the line but the length isn't there for the shot. It keeps a tad low too and disturbs the timber. Hales departs just after his fifty, he will know that there was a ton in the offing.

SIX! KABOOM! What a shot that is! Hales has had enough of plodding around. Steps out to the length ball and blasts it over long off for a maximum. That's gone for a flat maximum into the stands. Cracking stuff!
Wide! The short ball around off stump, Hales lets it over his head. Wide called for height.
Milne strays on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
10th ODI fifty for Hales.
Shortish in length and Hales swivels to pull it down to fine leg for a single. Hales continues to keep up his good form.
Length ball around off, tapped gently towards point where Broom fumbles to concede a single.

FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! Width on offer and Root reaches it to steer it with an angled bat. Uses the pace to his advantage and beats Broom at point comfortably. Third man had no chance of cutting it off although Boult did try. Nearly hurt himself too in the process.

Poor shot from Hales! He steps out to a length ball and tries to whack wildly across the line. Gets beaten as the ball carries through to Ronchi. Probably shot out of frustration from Alex as his scoring rate has dipped a bit in recent overs.
Good length outside off, punched firmly towards the man at cover.
Length ball around off stump, Root delays the dab to beat a diving Broom at point to his left. Single to third man.
Back of a length around off stump, Root hangs back and dabs it towards backward point.
On a length outside off, gets forward and pushes it to cover.

FOUR! Finds the edge but no slip in place. On a good length around off stump, Root pokes tentatively at it. Gets a thickish edge that flies wide of the keeper to the third man fence. Joe has a big smile on his face, he knows he got away there. 100 up for England.
Jimmy Neesham is introduced into the attack.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Shortish again outside off, this time Broom at point cannot stop the back foot punch despite putting in a big dive. Single to sweeper cover.
Back of a length outside off, punched firmly towards point where Broom makes a good stop. Saved some runs there.
Banged in short on off stump, Root ducks under the bumper.
Shortish around off stump, Hales swivels and pulls it uppishly through mid-wicket. Single taken.
Fullish length around off stump, Hales plays a punchy drive towards mid off.
Floated on middle and leg, nudged towards mid-wicket.
Fine leg comes up.
FOUR! Wrong line from Santner, slides it down the leg side and all that Root has to to do is get bat on it. Sweeps it fine down the leg side to pick up a boundary.
Mid on drops back.
Looped up on the stumps, Root gets across and pats it towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, Root gets forward and pushes gently towards cover.
Drifting in from around off stump, tapped gently towards point.

SIX! DUMPED! Root isn't letting Santner to settle. Tossed up around off stump, Joe steps down the track and lofts it comfortably over long on for a biggie. Beautiful batting this, nice footwork and clean striking.
Shortish around off stump, Hales swats it through mid-wicket for a brace. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two. They seem to love batting together, don't they?
Another short ball from Milne, Hales ducks again and this time wide is given for height.
Fuller on middle and leg, Hales fails to connect the clip and is rapped on the pads.
Short ball this time, Hales decides to evade the bumper.
Milne is on a good length on off stump, Hales stays on the back foot and blocks with a straight bat.
Good length on off stump, Hales stays in the crease and closes the bat face to jam it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, stays on the back foot and blocks it towards mid on.
Adam Milne is back on.

Time for Drinks! The hosts England will be really happy with the proceedings so far. Root and Hales are cruising along and they look steady in the middle. The Kiwis will want a wicket quickly so that they can get back into the game.
Hales slog sweeps it towards the fielder deep at mid-wicket for a single.
Root drives it through the point region for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Root flicks it uppishly towards mid on. Goes on the bounce towards the fielder.
Another full toss outside off, Root carves this one behind point for a couple.
Full toss outside off, Root drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Floated around off, Root kneels down and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Root clips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Hales pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Hales ducks under it.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Hales tries to clip it through but fails to make contact.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Hales clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery around off, Root punches it through covers for a single.
Slower delivery on a fuller length outside off, Hales punches it towards the fielder at mid off. Williamson makes a rare misfield which allows the batsman run a single.
Root stays in his crease and drives it straight to the fielder at covers. No runs taken.
Hales gets a bit forward and drives it through the extra cover region for a single.
Root drives it through covers for a single.
SIX! Root takes the charge! Floats this one around off, Root dances down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and sends the ball deep into the stands behind long on for half a dozen.
Root clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Hales drives it uppishly past the bowler towards long off for a single. Santner dived to his left on his followthrough but couldn't reach it. The ball was still way far from him.
Slower delivery around off, Hales stays deep in his crease and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single to keep strike.
Fuller outside off, Root kneels a bit and punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, Root clips it firmly straight to the fielder at mid on.
Short delivery into the body, Hales pulls it through the square leg region for a single.
Length delivery into the stumps, Hales defends it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Root clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Very full into the stumps, Root clips it towards the wide mid on region for a single.
Short outside off, Hales punches it towards the fielder at sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller around off, Root drives it towards the fielder at long off for a single.
Floated around middle, Root gets it towards the fielder at mid-wicket off the inner half of his bat.
Hales stays in his crease and punches it through covers for a single.
Hales gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Spin is introduced into the attack. Mitchell Santner has been handed the ball.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Hales pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Root clips it through the mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery around off, Hales gets beaten by the lack of pace. Tries to defend it but ends up getting a leading edge through the cover region for a single.
A steady start for England. They have done well in the first Powerplay and they will look to continue well.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been taken. Maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle. Corey Anderson is called in for a bowl.
FOUR! A bit risky but surely worth it! Fuller length delivery around off, Hales whips it powerfully over the leaping mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, Hales punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, the ball zips off the surface. Hales tries to feel it but gets beaten by the extra pace.
Good length delivery outside off, Root tries to punch through covers but ends up getting an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Hales stays in his crease and pulls it just over the fielder at mid-wicket. Boult puts in a dive and saves a run for his team as he gives it a chase from mid on.
Root punches it through covers for a single.
Length delivery around off, Root shuffles a bit and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Joe punches it straight to the fielder at covers off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, Root dabs it straight towards the fielder at point.
Root gets off the mark! Good length delivery outside off, Root punches it past the diving point fielder for a couple.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Angling into the hips, Hales clips it towards the square leg region for a single.
Joe Root will bat at number 3!

OUT! Roy pays the price for the shuffle! Fuller delivery into the leg stump, he comes way across and tries to clip it fine on the leg side. Misses it and the ball kisses his front pad and then the ball goes onto disturb his stumps. If the ball hadn't hit the stumps, he would have been adjudged LBW for sure. Another failure for him. Smart bowling from Adam Milne as he had judged the batsman's movement really early. Milne successfully draws first blood of this encounter and the struggling innings of Jason Roy comes to an end.
Another on the up drive but this time straight to the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller delivery outside off, Roy shuffles way across and drives it crisply down the ground through the mid off region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Roy pushes it towards the cover fielder of the front foot.
Fuller delivery outside off, Hales pushes it towards the extra-cover region for another single.
Length delivery outside off, Roy just defends it towards extra cover with soft hands and scampers across for a single.
Adam Milne is introduced into the attack.
Slower delivery way outside off, Hales misses out on the loosener as he cuts it straight towards the fielder at point.
Good length delivery around off and curving away. Hales punches this one of the back foot towards the fielder at covers.

A slight drizzle. Meanwhile, there is a nationwide one-minute silence being observed for the victims of the recent terror attacks in the UK at 1100 local, which is right now. Play halts temporarily as all the players, umpires and everybody on the ground stand up for the same.

FOUR! Good shot! Another good length delivery around off, Hales dances down the track and slaps it over the point region for a boundary. That was a terrific hit and seems like Hales is done with ball watching.
Short delivery into the batsman, Hales lets it through as he sways away from the line of the ball.
Hales stays in his crease and drives this one straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Hales stays behind and punches it on the off side.
Low full toss outside off, Hales throws his bat at it. Carves it through the gap between point and cover. Neesham gives it a chase and the batsmen run three.
Dabbed towards third man for a single.
Slower delivery way outside off, Roy drives it firmly back to the bowler. Boult slips and stops the ball in his followthrough.
Short delivery around off, Roy goes for the pull. He is a bit early into the short. Gets a bottom edge which rolls away towards the fielder at point.
Length delivery angling across, Roy stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller delivery outside off, Roy gets forward a bit and defends it back to the bowler.

Stifled appeal for LBW! Fuller length delivery and angling into the pads, Hales tries to defend it but gets beaten by the inward movement. Misses it completely as the ball goes onto hit the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. It was surely going down leg so it was a good call by the umpire.
Fuller delivery around off, Hales gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Another short delivery outside off, Hales goes for the pull but he fails to make contact.
Very full into the stumps, Hales gets his bat down in time to defend it.
Short delivery into the batsman, Roy pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Fine leg came up, square leg dropped back before the start of this over.
Angling in from a good length, Roy fails to clip it through and gets rapped on the thigh pad.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Hales goes for the hook shot but fails to make contact.
Short delivery into the batsman, Hales ducks under it.
SIX! First maximum of the day! Short and into the batsman, Hales pounces on it and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
Again width from Boult this time, Hales punches it through the cover-point region for a couple.
Boult comes around the wicket, pitches this one on a length outside off. Hales defends it well from his crease.
Hales gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
A bit of confusion here. Bruce Oxenford has a talk with the scorers and calls it an over finally.
Down the leg side this time, Roy shuffles across a bit and flicks it through the square leg region for a single.
Another good length delivery, Roy has his defence well in place there.
Length delivery outside off, Roy punches it on the up towards the cover region. Santner puts in a dive to his right to save a certain boundary.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Roy gets forward and tries to defend it. Gets it towards the mid-wicket fielder off the inner half of his bat.
Good length delivery around off, Roy stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Angling into the stumps from a fuller length, Hales reads the length well and clips it beautifully through the mid-wicket region. Corey Anderson gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
Hales stays in his crease and punches it towards the extra cover region. The fielder from wide mid off puts in a dive and saves a run for his team. The batsmen scamper across for a single.
Alex stays in his crease and clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angling in from around middle and leg, Hales tries to clip it through. Gets a faint inside edge which goes onto hit him on his pads.
Hales dabs it towards the point fielder.
FOUR! That's creamed! Width outside off by Boult this time, Hales pounces it and slashes it through the point region for a boundary. Hales gets off the mark with that one.
Fuller delivery outside off, Hales gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Trent Boult on his 50th ODI will bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Coincidentally it is also umpire Paul Reifell's 50th ODI as well.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Good shot! Fuller delivery outside off, Roy prods forward and shows his elegant face of his bat to drive it crisply through covers. McCullum on air had just mentioned that Roy just needs a couple of boundaries to get back in nick. Could this be the start he needed?
Uses the width of the crease this time Southee. Angles it into the hips, Roy cannot clip it through as he gets rapped high on the thigh pad.
Angling into the batsman this time, Roy comes a bit forward to negotiate the swing. He successfully punches it towards the fielder at mid on.
Another good length delivery outside off, Roy tries to poke at it but gets beaten by the away movement.
Good length delivery around off, a bit of movement in the air. The ball nips away after pitching. Roy gets behind it and defends it neatly.

The nationals anthems are done and dusted! We are all set for the match to get underway. Alex Hales and Jason Roy will open the batting for England. New Zealand, on the other hand, have handed Tim Southee with the responsibility of the first new ball. There are two slips in place. Here we go....

Pitch Report - Nasser Hussain doing the pitch report says that there is a good covering of grass on the deck. Mentions that the pitch was covered throughout the day yesterday as it rained a lot. Feels that both the teams will play one spinner each as the boundary on one side is really short. Reckons that the captain winning the toss will opt to bowl and ends by saying that this is the game which will be dictated by the seamers.

EOIN MORGAN says that they would have bowled first as well due to the early morning start. Reveals that there is one forced change, Chris Woakes' exit to injury means that ADIL RASHID comes in. Maintains that the availability of Ben Stokes as an all-rounder allows them to play a seamer less. Maintains that Ben is fully fit for this game. Knows that a win here ensures England a semifinal spot and hopes his side can get the job done.

KANE WILLIAMSON says that they will bowl. Seems a good pitch and hopes his bowlers can make use of the overhead conditions. Opines that they did well against Australia despite the no result and hopes they can keep the momentum going. Expects his side to maintain their style of positive cricket. NZ ARE UNCHANGED.
TOSS - NEW ZEALAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD.

The Kiwis, on the other hand, will be really disappointed as rain played spoilsport during their game against Australia in which they were sensing victory. Kane Williamson has been leading his side from the front and he will want another good performance today as a defeat could put their hope of qualification for the semifinals in real doubt. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to Cardiff for the Match 6 of the 2017 Champions Trophy. England will be hosting New Zealand for their second game of the group stage. The home side is the only one in group A to win a game as all the others have been rain affected. That means if they win today they are certain of a spot in the knockout stages.
